text:
[Act: insolvency
 Chapter: Adjudicating Authority for Individuals and Partnership Firms
 Section: 183A::Penalty for initiating frivolous or vexatious proceedings under Part III.
]


If, any person has initiated a frivolous or vexatious proceeding before the Adjudicating Authority under this Part, it may impose upon such person a penalty which shall not be less than one lakh rupees but which may extend to two crore rupees.]
